_meta.about: Offline fallback Models.dev-shaped catalog snapshot for Codewhale (#3385, demoted by #4188, generated since #6396).
_meta.compatibility_fallback: Legacy Together and Fireworks defaults and previously reviewed curated IDs retain their dated metadata when absent upstream; they do not prove current availability. See each curated reason. Refreshed provider/catalog rows and explicit configuration remain authoritative.
_meta.role: NOT a competing source of truth. Preferred metadata is the live Models.dev catalog published into ProviderLake (#4187). This asset is used only when live/cache rows are unavailable (offline startup, failed refresh, or empty cache).
_meta.source: Rows are projected unedited from Models.dev onto the fields models_dev.rs reads; provider headers, id mapping, defaults and canonical joins come from scripts/catalog/models_dev_seed.toml.
_meta.corrections: Deliberate holds (withheld prices, clamped limits) are not in this file. They live in crates/config/assets/catalog_corrections.json and apply to this seed and to live refresh alike.
_meta.default_rows: Each provider's `default: true` wire id equals that provider's built-in DEFAULT_*_MODEL so RouteResolver::new() and the descriptor stay in agreement when offline.
_meta.pending_release_metadata: GLM-5.3 is live on the Z.ai Coding Plan (docs.z.ai/devpack/overview and docs.z.ai/devpack/latest-model, recorded 2026-08-13) and is the default direct Z.ai model (DEFAULT_ZAI_MODEL); explicit GLM-5.2 selections keep their own id. First-party wire id is GLM-5.3; OpenRouter mirror is z-ai/glm-5.3. Capability/limit/dialect values still inherit from GLM-5.2 until Z.ai publishes distinct 5.3 numbers. Pricing stays absent: Coding Plan publishes credit multipliers, not a USD PAYG row we can stand behind. Z.ai may auto-route GLM-5.2/GLM-5.1 requests to GLM-5.3 on their side; Codewhale still sends the selected picker id. Do not send a [1m] suffix. Scope stays first-party Z.ai plus the OpenRouter mirror; add third-party gateway rows only against that gateway's own published roster.
_meta.generated_by: python3 scripts/catalog_models_dev.py seed render from scripts/catalog/models_dev_seed.toml and scripts/catalog/models_dev_seed.lock.json. Do not edit this file by hand; see docs/CATALOG_REFRESH.md.
